edge_cases.rationale: The unsupported branch is honestly displayed per probe (row-* show UNSUPPORTED here) and the fallback panels render, but the mislabeled column-* probes claim grid/flex support this browser does not have.

references.rationale: Fixed 2026-10-04 (weekly hardening): the page now links https://chromestatus.com/feature/5157805733183488, matching its feature index — restoring invariant 3 and the fix-slugs self-heal. Verified by grep against the canonical id on the feature index.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite covers the real surface and honestly fails 6 of 8 here; notably it uses the `rule` shorthand where this page probes `gap-rule`.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Cloud-fallback observation only, NOT browser-verified per auto-research.md §0 — headless Chromium 141 (full-page screenshot + DOM, not chrome-devtools-mcp): probe cards render green column-*/red row-* states, native panels show rule-less layouts beside bordered fallbacks, conformance panel 2/6/0; no interactions existed to drive. chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable in this cloud session (the auto-research.md section-0 blocker applies, so this is NOT browser verification): what was exercised is page load, full-page screenshot read, served/dumped DOM state and the /conformance/ route result; driving every control and capturing console/network evidence remains for an MCP-equipped session.

design_system.rationale: Colours are variables, but body/badge text runs 0.5–0.58rem (≈8–9px), well below legible size for probe verdicts and code snippets.

accessibility.rationale: Probe results are text+colour badges (good) but injected with no live region, headings structure is fine, yet the ≈8px type and colour-paired badges make verdicts hard to perceive for low-vision users.

summary: Reviewed with the headless-Chromium-141 cloud fallback (not chrome-devtools-mcp): full-page screenshot + DOM of /v149/css-gap-decorations/compatibility-lab/ and the feature /conformance/ route (HTTP 200; panel 2 pass / 6 fail / 0 blocked). The lab's bottom half (progressive-enhancement pattern gating on row-rule) is exactly right, and row-rule/gap-rule probes honestly read UNSUPPORTED here — but the column-rule probes claim grid/flex context they cannot test and show green over rule-less panels, the page lacks any ChromeStatus reference, the promised repeat() probe is absent, and the type size is ≈8px. No user controls existed to drive. 2026-11-26 daily build: column-rule probes relabelled PARSES (multicol-era) with an explicit 'not evidence of grid/flex' note; gap-decoration-only probes added (row-rule, rule, repeat() rule list, rule-break, rule-inset, rule-visibility-items); gap-rule kept as a labelled stale draft name (rejected in Chrome 158); grid/flex painting is stated as an inference from row-rule+rule; type raised to >=0.7rem.
